question:
Let \(P\) be an interior point of the triangle \(\Delta ABC\). Assume that \(AP,BP\) and \(CP\) meet the opposite sides \(BC,CA\) and \(AB\) at \(D,E\) and \(F\), respectively. Show that
\[
\frac{AF}{FB}+\frac{AE}{EC}=\frac{AP}{PD}.
\]

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
